```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```
#| execute:
  echo: false
```{r}
billboard |> 
  select(artist, track, date.entered, wk1:wk4)
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = wk6)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Week 6 Rankings",
    subtitle = "Rankings for songs in their 6th week on the Billboard chart (n = 280)",
    x = "Week 6 Rank",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  select(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |> 
  summarize(
    present = sum(!is.na(rank)),
    missing = sum(is.na(rank)),
    .by = week
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Song Rankings Over Time",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Rank"
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |> 
  summarize(
    re_entered = any(diff(week) > 1),
    .by = c(artist, track)
  ) |> 
  count(re_entered)
```

```{r}
billboard_summary <- billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |> 
  arrange(week) |> 
  summarize(
    first_rank = first(rank),
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best = week[which.min(rank)],
    total_weeks = n(),
    .by = c(artist, track)
  )

billboard_summary
```

```{r}
# Fastest to #1
billboard_summary |> 
  filter(best_rank == 1) |> 
  slice_min(first_week_at_best, n = 1)

# Slowest to #1
billboard_summary |> 
  filter(best_rank == 1) |> 
  slice_max(first_week_at_best, n = 1)

# Top-10 song with longest chart run
billboard_summary |> 
  filter(best_rank <= 10) |> 
  slice_max(total_weeks, n = 1)
```
